target.title: fix(ui): restore WCAG AA contrast for muted webchat text (AI-assisted)
target.body:
Closes #107299

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where webchat users on the dark theme would see secondary text (message timestamps, slash-menu argument hints) that falls below WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1), even though the shared `--muted` token itself already meets AA on declared dark backgrounds.

## Why This Change Was Made

Prior closed PR #107562 brightened the shared dark `--muted` tokens globally. ClawSweeper correctly blocked that: at current `main`, `#8b8b94` / `#898990` already pass AA on `--bg`, `--bg-elevated`, and `--bg-muted`.

The remaining HEAD failure is composited opacity on real chat selectors:

| Selector | Before | Composited on `--bg` | AA |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.chat-group-timestamp` | `color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.7` | ~3.34:1 | FAIL |
| `.slash-menu-args` | `color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.65` | ~3.04:1 | FAIL |

This PR removes that opacity dimming so muted text renders at the already-AA token color, documents the dark-theme AA floor in `base.css`, and adds a regression test for token and composited pairings.

AI-assisted contribution (Cursor/Grok). Human author: Stan Shih (stantheman0128).

## User Impact

- Dark-theme message timestamps and slash-command argument hints are readable at WCAG AA.
- Shared theme tokens are unchanged, so unrelated muted surfaces keep their intended hierarchy.
- Future palette or opacity regressions on these pairings fail CI via `theme-contrast.test.ts`.

## Evidence

Computed contrast (sRGB relative luminance) on current `main` tokens `--muted #8b8b94`:

**Before (opacity composite on `--bg #0e1015`):**
- timestamp `opacity: 0.7` => ~3.34:1 FAIL
- slash-args `opacity: 0.65` => ~3.04:1 FAIL

**After (full-opacity `--muted`):**
- on `--bg #0e1015`: 5.63:1 PASS
- on `--bg-elevated #191c24`: 5.04:1 PASS
- on `--bg-muted #1f2330`: 4.64:1 PASS
- on `--card #161920`: 5.21:1 PASS

Focused test:

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui.config.ts ui/src/styles/theme-contrast.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
```

CI follow-up (`8a3c09633c`): narrowed luminance/CSS-var helpers with proper undefined guards so `pnpm check:test-types` passes under strict indexed access. Local re-run: vitest 2/2 passed; `pnpm check:test-types` exit 0.

Dark-theme Control UI screenshot still blocked here: no local Control UI session was available to capture a redacted after-fix browser artifact in this pass.

Related: closed unmerged #107562 (token brightening without current-main failing selector). This PR addresses the proven composited failure instead.
